app.name: Brusnika.LMS
app.short_description: Embed Brusnika.LMS inside Zendesk. Train agents without leaving your support workflow.
app.long_description:
Brusnika.LMS for Zendesk embeds your learning management system directly inside the Zendesk top bar. Agents get seamless single sign-on access to their training courses without leaving Zendesk. Admins can assign courses, track completion rates, and manage learning content — all connected to your Zendesk account automatically.

**Data disclosure:** This app accesses the following Zendesk data: the current agent's profile (ID, name, email address) and role for single sign-on authentication; the list of agents and groups to sync users and departments into Brusnika.LMS; and the ability to create tickets to notify agents of new training assignments. Agent profile data is transmitted to and processed on Brusnika.LMS servers (sa.eu.brusnika-apps.com), operated by Brusnika Solutions. No Zendesk ticket content, customer data, or conversation history is accessed or stored. For details, see our Privacy Policy at https://brusnika-lms.com/privacy
app.installation_instructions:
1. Click Install.
2. Open any ticket — the Brusnika.LMS icon will appear in the top bar.
3. Click the icon to launch the LMS. Your Zendesk account is connected automatically — no additional setup required.
